page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can calculate risk probabilities from sensor data, but safety professionals must personally insist that workers put helmets back on and corrective-action orders are truly signed. Machines cannot replace this on-site responsibility, which is why the occupation exists.

responsibilities: Conduct site inspections and risk assessments
Organize safety training and emergency drills
Investigate accidents and drive corrective action

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「被当摆设」——只填表不落地、不敢坚持，既出不了价值也守不住底线；真正敢扛事的安全专家，AI 越强越值钱。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「责任与人情」——提出整改要得罪人，事故追责时压力巨大；只做文书不落地，才是这行真正的职业风险。
risks: 事故追责压力大，责任终身制
整改推动难，得罪人、碰钉子
现场职业暴露与一线风险
法规趋严，合规压力逐年增加
只做文书不落地，职业价值被质疑

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能从传感器数据里算出风险概率，但让工人把那顶安全帽重新戴上、让那张整改单真正签下去，靠的是安全员在现场的坚持——这是机器代替不了的责任感，也是这个职业存在的理由。

responsibilities: 开展现场巡查与风险评估
组织安全培训与应急演练

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but preparation being taken over + intense assessment competition. Textbook-only lecturers are replaced first.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to the role is not AI, but the takeover of materials. Organization, compilation, and courseware absorb routine teaching preparation, putting textbook-only lecturers under the most pressure. Those who lead debates, design research, and make value judgments remain.
risks: Organization and compilation are taken over
Automatic courseware generation replaces manual work
Textbook-only roles decline
Research assessment pressure
Up-or-out pressure

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how well AI organizes materials, people must still identify why students fall into bias, build frameworks, clarify positions, and bring discussion back to logic. The human gatekeeper between materials and minds remains essential.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「准备被接管 + 考核卷」——只照本宣科的人最先被接走。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「资料被接管」——梳理、汇编与课件把常规教学准备接走，只照本宣科的人最承压；真正留下来的是能带辩论、能做研究设计、能做价值判断的人。
risks: 梳理与汇编被接手
课件自动生成替代人工
照本宣科岗在减少
科研考核压力

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管 AI 多能梳资料，那学生为啥绕进偏见、框架怎么搭、立场怎么守，还得人把讨论拉回逻辑去定——育人这头，从资料到脑子的把关人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but up-or-out systems + evaluations. Tools absorb basic lesson preparation, while people with research leadership become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI replacing teaching, but up-or-out systems + evaluation pressure. Research-output and funding requirements are high, while AI tools change lesson preparation and grading.

Intense funding competition
AI changes lesson preparation
Slow job growth

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent tools become, teachers still must decide which topics deserve depth, how to help students understand, and where research should go, using their minds to think, voices to explain, and hands to write. People cannot be fully removed from education.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「非升即走 + 考核」——基础备课被工具吃，有研究引领力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI 取代讲课，而是「非升即走 + 考核压力」——科研产出与经费要求高，且 AI 工具改变备课与批改方式。

Automated equipment replaces single-process jobs

Industry upgrades require learning new equipment and processes

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can inspect dimensions, identify defects, and optimize scheduling, but decisions about how to cut, construct the spine, and deliver the batch always remain in the binding worker's hands.
